rules_applied.batch_scales: fps(4096) >= 20 * fps(1), frozen in Step 2 and NOT changed in Step 8
rules_applied.never_certify_on_batch_1: GPU rows certify on the best batch above B=1
rules_applied.no_projections: a projection never stands in for a measurement
rules_applied.reference: an official renderer timed on the same host makes the ratio (S_cpu / R); otherwise NO_REFERENCE and the row certifies on the cores ladder
rules_applied.tiers: COPIED from the Step-7 record; recomputed only as a cross-check

roles: Step-6 generated tier tables + src legend
Step-7 record: per-id tiers, cells, pixel/symbolic
cross-check: Workstream E support matrix (tier columns)
frozen Step-2 certification spec (ladders, bars, qualifiers)

status_vocabulary.MEASURED: a tier was measured for this device and it is a GRADE, not a gate: CPU_REGRESSION is measured
status_vocabulary.MISSING-UNSUPPORTED_BY_DESIGN: the renderer raises on this device by design rather than falling back to the other one
status_vocabulary.UNMEASURED: no usable measurement exists (never run, blocked, or load-quarantined)
status_vocabulary.UNSUPPORTED_BY_DESIGN: this id produces no frame at all (symbolic)

what_this_is: Step-8 Workstream G: the final CPU/GPU tier accounting for all 42 registered stable_worldmodel ids, assembled from committed Step-6/Step-7 artifacts. Nothing was re-measured and no threshold was moved.
